short_description: A lying version of the lateral raise that isolates the lateral deltoid while eliminating momentum.
how_to: Lie on your side with one dumbbell in the top hand.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Raise the top arm directly upward until it is vertical.
Lower it slowly back down.
Complete all reps then switch sides.
correct: Keep your body still and stable.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
mistakes: Don't swing the weight up with momentum.
Don't roll your torso back to assist the lift.
Don't raise beyond the vertical.
Don't let the weight drop fast.

short_description: A gentle mobility drill that loosens the shoulders and upper trapezius.
how_to: Stand or sit tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift both shoulders toward your ears.
Roll them backward and then downward in a smooth circle.
Complete several rotations, then reverse direction.
correct: Move through the full circle slowly.
mistakes: Don't rush the movement.
Don't tense your neck as you roll.
Don't jut your head forward.
Don't cut the circle short.

short_description: A shoulder warm-up drill that uses circular arm movements to improve joint mobility.
how_to: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms straight out to your sides.
Begin making small circles forward.
Gradually widen the circles.
Reverse direction for the same number of rotations.
correct: Keep your arms at shoulder height throughout.
Keep your movements smooth and controlled.
mistakes: Don't let your arms drop below shoulder height.
Don't tense your shoulders up by your ears.
Don't rush the circles.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A beginner pressing exercise that builds chest and shoulder strength using the wall for support.
how_to: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at shoulder height and width.
Step back so your arms are extended.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start until your arms are straight.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Keep your elbows controlled on the way in.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't let your head push forward on the way in.
Don't stand too close to reduce the challenge.

short_description: A dumbbell exercise that lifts the arms forward to strengthen the front deltoids.
how_to: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise both arms forward to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower the weights slowly back down.
correct: Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
mistakes: Don't swing your torso back to lift.
Don't raise the weights above shoulder height.
Don't let the weights drop fast.
Don't shrug your shoulders during the raise.

short_description: A bodyweight biceps exercise that uses a doorframe for resistance.
how_to: Stand in a doorway and grip both sides of the frame at about hip height.
Lean your body weight back slightly.
Curl your body upward by pulling through your biceps.
Lower yourself back to the start with control.
Repeat for the desired reps.
correct: Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Keep your body in a straight line.
mistakes: Don't swing your hips to assist the curl.
Don't let your elbows flare out.
Don't drop back fast on the way down.
Don't grip the frame so hard your forearms dominate the movement.

short_description: A machine or barbell hamstring curl that isolates the back of the thighs.
how_to: Lie face down with the barbell pad against the back of your ankles.
Keep your hips pressed down into the bench.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower the weight slowly back down.
correct: Keep your hips pressed down throughout.
mistakes: Don't let your hips rise off the bench.
Don't swing the weight up with momentum.
Don't drop the weight fast on the way down.
Don't lock your knees hard at the bottom.

short_description: A modified push-up isometric hold from the knees that builds chest and triceps endurance.
how_to: Start in a modified push-up position on your knees with hands under your shoulders.
Lower yourself halfway until your elbows are bent.
Hold there with your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Breathe steadily and maintain the position for the target time.
correct: Keep your body straight from knees to head.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't raise your hips above the line of your body.
Don't hold your breath.

short_description: A single-arm lateral raise that targets the lateral deltoid while allowing focused control on each side.
how_to: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise the arm out to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the weight slowly and repeat before switching sides.
correct: Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
mistakes: Don't tilt your torso to the opposite side.
Don't shrug your shoulder as you raise.
Don't swing the weight up with momentum.
Don't let the weight drop fast.

short_description: A strict push-up variation with elbows close to the body that targets the triceps and chest.
how_to: Start in a push-up position with your hands directly under your shoulders.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Lower your chest to the floor in a straight line.
Push back up to the start position.
Repeat with a steady rhythm.
correct: Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Keep your elbows controlled close to your body.
mistakes: Don't let your hips drop.
Don't flare your elbows out wide.
Don't let your lower back arch.
Don't rush and shorten the range of motion.
